verdict.rationale: ROCm's own GPU architecture specifications list the MI325X (CDNA3) with LLVM compile target gfx942, and the Instinct docs provide a dedicated MI325X system acceptance guide alongside HIP C++ and OpenMP programming docs. That is first-party ROCm/HIP documentation naming the part as a toolchain target. missing for 10: an explicit 'supported GPUs' compatibility-matrix entry in the evidence, and independent or hands-on confirmation of compiling and running workloads on MI325X.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship GPU-compute workloads on the vendor's toolchain — CUDA or ROCm/HIP documentation lists this part as a supported target
